title: CultureBot
read_scope: Methods and evaluation §§3–5; Tables1–4; conclusion (targeted reading, not all appendices)
task: Natural-language exploration of cultural collection records
data: 81852 SearchCulture records;6 experts;55 authored queries;250 evaluation sessions (author-reported)
intervention: KG-guided retrieval plus same textual retrieval/generation as no-KG ablation
evaluation: 12 rubric criteria mapped0–3; same-query comparisons with Holm-corrected Wilcoxon; Table1 counts differ per system; paired complete subset n110
result: Overall quality2.34/3 with KG vs2.00 without; evidence-grounding rubric2.59 vs2.09. These are expert ratings, not QA exact-match or claim-entailment rates.
limits: 55 queries not250 independent questions; expert-authored/rated items and unequal rating counts need examination; source-linked grounding not automatically atomic support or causal faithfulness. Not all hardest queries improve materially.
project_implication: Strong domain-nearest comparator for any heritage KG contribution. Need matched no-KG ablation and evidence-set/provenance labels rather than only adding a graph.
publication_eligibility: arXiv version read; published venue not confirmed, retain novelty watchlist

title: HeriKGQA
read_scope: §§2–4, Table1 and evaluation definitions; targeted, not entire appendices
task: Quantitative QA over heritage sensor records, spatial/temporal/anomaly/follow-up
data: Fixed snapshot5 sites,71 nodes,5227617 observations,37 rules;500 questions=100/type (reported)
intervention: Ontology-constrained intent parsing, deterministic SPARQL compilation/computation, grounding layer and error correction; LLM phrases answers
evaluation: Requested numerical claim must match manually validated reference; anomaly verdict and unanswerable declination included. Quality/readability judge is separate from numeric accuracy; same LLM across systems but schema/tools/demonstrations vary.
result: 495/500=99.0% accuracy; strongest baseline80.8%; without grounding86.8%. Median12.0s vs Interactive-KBQA46.7s.
limits: Accuracy on constrained sensor computations does not transfer to open curatorial prose; cannot attribute all gain to KG because baselines expose different tools/schema. Number-occurrence check does not fully verify number-to-sensor/time association (§3.3).
project_implication: Consider deterministic tools for dates/counts/relations. Distinguish entity KG retrieval, symbolic computation and claim support; evaluate each component with matched controls.
publication_eligibility: arXiv version read; published venue not confirmed

title: RAG-RewardBench
read_scope: §3.1–3.3 scenario design, reported study overview and Limitations; targeted extraction
task: Ranking reward-model preferences for RAG responses, not directly museum assistant QA
data: 18 RAG subsets,6 retrievers,24 RALMs,45 reward models reported; citations/multi-hop/appropriate abstain/conflict robustness
intervention: Purpose-built scenarios and LLM preference judgments checked against human judgments
evaluation: Reward preference accuracy/correlation differs from citation support score or operational answer accuracy; appropriate-abstain subset and synthetic counterfactual documents already exist.
result: Reports judge/human correlation0.864 and challenges to RMs; no cross-paper numeric comparison attempted.
limits: Do not infer an assistant achieves a rate from a reward-model ranking result; source language/domain and judge validation need explicit transfer check. Paper identifies multidimensional scoring as possible improvement.
project_implication: A benchmark combining citation/abstention/conflict categories is not by itself new. Need museum-specific evidence problems and validated annotation/experimental question.
publication_eligibility: ACL Findings2025 publisher PDF retrieved; full formal eligibility/quality adjudication not done

title: ALCE
read_scope: Task/datasets§2, metrics§3.2–3.3 and baseline setup§4; targeted extraction
task: End-to-end retrieve then generate text with citations
data: ASQA,QAMPARI,ELI5; retrieval corpora and supporting passages
intervention: Reproducible benchmark, correctness/fluency/citation metrics and prompting baselines
evaluation: Citation recall averages statements with cited-passages jointly entailing statement; citation precision removes irrelevant citations without demanding a minimal citation set. NLI TRUE plus human validation; correctness separate.
result: Demonstrates incomplete citation support among strong systems; no new evaluation run or copied performance claim here.
limits: Entailment from cited text does not prove historical truth or causal use; evaluator/domain/language validity matters. Multi-passage joint support is allowed, not just one-source matching.
project_implication: Use as mandatory citation-evaluation baseline; keep generation correctness, citation support and coverage separate; new metric needs improvement beyond renaming ALCE.
publication_eligibility: EMNLP2023 publisher PDF retrieved; formal review not declared complete
